content:
When buﬀers are full for pipelines with an S3 source, the pipelines stop processing SQS
notiﬁcations. As the buﬀers are freed up, the pipelines start processing notiﬁcations again.
If a sink is down or unable to ingest data and end-to-end acknowledgement is enabled
for the source, the pipeline stops processing SQS notiﬁcations until it receives a successful
acknowledgement from all sinks.
